AngleExpr.description: An angle: a number of degrees, or an expression such as "30 deg" or "a / 2".

EdgeRef.description: An edge: a point in mm on it ([x, y, z], {"x", "y", "z"} or {"point": [x, y, z]}), or {"body", "index"} in the body's edge order (an index written without a fraction).

LengthExpr.description: A length: a number in the design's length unit, or an expression such as "w / 2" or "30 mm".

Point3.description: A point in mm: [x, y, z] or {"x", "y", "z"}.

StringList.description: A name, or a list of names.

input.description:
Bevel edges of a body with a flat face: `distance` back from each edge along both faces, or
along the first face with `distance2` along the second, or with the bevel at `angle` from the
first. Giving both `distance2` and `angle` is the handler's to refuse.

angle.description: The bevel's angle from the first face. Not with `distance2`.

body.description: The body whose edges the points pick. Default: whichever body has an edge there.

body_names.description: Names for the new bodies, in order.

distance.description:
How far the bevel cuts back from the edge: along both faces, or along the first face when
`distance2` or `angle` is given.

distance2.description: How far the bevel cuts back along the second face. Not with `angle`.

edges.description: The edges to bevel: a point on each, or `{body, index}`.

flip.description:
Which face is first: by default the one facing up most; true takes the other. Default:
false.

name.description: The feature's name in the timeline.

participants.description:
The bodies taking part, each an existing body or `*`; what that changes depends on the
feature.

tangent_chain.description:
Cut each picked edge's tangent chain with it. Default: true; false cuts exactly the picked
edges.

input.title: ChamferParams

label: Chamfer

FeatureNotice.description: Something a feature's result tells the user without stopping them, with an action to take.

action.description: The command that changes the feature as the notice offers.

contact.description:
How the bodies split off touched the others: `along_edge`, `at_point` or `touching` (along
a line or at a point their boundaries don't hold).

NoticeAction.description: A command a notice offers to run.

changed_bodies.description: Bodies that were there before and now have other geometry.

ms.description: How long the feature took to evaluate, in milliseconds.

notice.description:
A join that split pieces into bodies of their own because they touch the others only along
an edge or at a point (its `touching: separate`): what to tell the user, and the edit that
makes them one body instead. Left out otherwise, also when the join kept pieces that touch
nothing in one body.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

warning.description:
A warning from the evaluation (a Boolean that needed a retry, a reference found again
elsewhere), or `null`.

params: edges: [[x,y,z] | {body, index}] ; distance: expr; tangent_chain?: bool (default true: each picked edge's tangent chain is cut with it; false: exactly the picked edges); distance2?: expr (along the second face) | angle?: expr (from the first face); flip?: bool (which face is first: by default the one facing up most); body?: the body the edges are on (without it, each point is looked up on every placed body, shown or hidden, and a point on edges of 2 bodies is refused, naming them)
